text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At last, it is time for Narita Taishin to 
run in her Debut race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Taishin seemed restless 
for some reason...
choice_data_list: Let's take a deep breath, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. It's not like... I'm scared or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin-san! It is time to move to 
the paddock, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm heading out now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she left after saying that, her footing 
was trembling ever so slightly.
choice_data_list:
(Is there some way I can cheer her 
up...!?)

(I wonder if there's some way I can cheer 
her up...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, a large crowd packed the paddock 
once again, hoping to catch a glimpse of 
the Umamusume who might one day make 
history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, Narita Taishin showed up――

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh, what's that? That Umamusume is 
awfully petite.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Can she really compete with others with a 
physique like that? If she's not careful, 
she'll get sent flying...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is she going to be okay? I hope she 
didn't get hurt..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No cheers of excitement arise. Enveloped 
in a swirl of anxious murmurs, Narita 
Taishin slightly lowers her head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, it is a fact that her build is 
a disadvantage in races.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Your body is way too small!" "Your limbs 
are far too thin!" "You're not an 
Umamusume who belongs on a racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sick and tired of hearing every single 
bit of it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still, listen up! No matter what anyone 
says, I'm gonna stand on that turf! And to 
all those people who mocked me and looked 
down on me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Take that! This is right where I belong!" 
she thought!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna stand in the winner's circle and 
show everyone my biggest smile!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An obsession with victory stronger than 
anyone else's. And Narita Taishin 
possesses the sheer ability to make it a 
reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I know that better than 
anyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I realized it, I had cried out.
choice_data_list: Go, Taishin, you can do it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey... S-Shut up!! What do you think 
you're doing?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... I see. Yeah, you're right. It's 
her debut, so we ought to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I'm cheering for youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, that idiot...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'll win first, then definitely kick 
him later!
